decisions.reason: Using the existing platform as the Shopline widget's content source does not change the separate AI mood-board generation capability, provider, interaction mode, or scope.
The Shopline content-source decision does not alter the separate task of evaluating selfie styling through the backend and delivering the results.
The Shopline widget's retrieval of content from the existing platform does not change the Veyra AI provider constraint or the exclusion of OpenAI from production implementation.
